comment: The P. V/OCT inputs are halved before use: Rainbow.cpp:716-717 multiplies the jack by 0.5 and clamps to plus or minus 5, and Tuning.cpp:64 and 76 raise two to that figure, so in the two MaxQ filter modes the jack needs 2V for an octave. The manual says the opposite, that the jack is 1V per octave with MaxQ and about 2V per octave with BpRe; the code wins, and this is why those two jacks are marked as plain CV rather than as pitch inputs. In the BpRe mode the same jack is added to the nudge knob's 0 to 4095 figure and divided by 4096 (Tuning.cpp:188 and 196), so it moves the filter by about a thousandth of the way to the next note and does almost nothing. The six level indicators beside the sliders are parameters with widgets, so they can be clicked and dragged, but Rainbow.cpp:768 writes the running output level into each of them every sample; moving one is undone in the same frame. Two more parameters, SLEWON and COMPRESS, are marked obsolete in the source and have no widget, and the fourth output, POLY_DEBUG, has no jack on the panel; none of the three can be clicked and none gets a line. Spread is the raw knob shifted right by eight and increased by one, giving whole-number gaps of 1 to 16 notes, with filter 3 as the fixed point (Rainbow.cpp:894 and Rotation.cpp:164). The channel level can reach 2, which is why channels 7 to 12 of POLY ENV reach 20V (Levels.cpp:62-68). Scale ring notes are blocked by clicking the ring display, which is a drawn widget rather than a parameter. The manual's tips say the audio output is not limited; Audio.cpp:115, 217-218 and 309 clamp every output sample to plus or minus 5V, so in this build it is.
